reasoning: To secure the crown jewels, we must block all internet-facing paths where attackers can exploit known exploited vulnerabilities (KEV) to gain initial access. The prioritized findings represent all open KEV vulnerabilities on internet-facing assets that serve as entry points into the network. Fixing this set eliminates the primary external attack vectors leading toward internal resources.

input.sql:
SELECT 
    f.id as finding_id, 
    v.cve, 
    v.cvss, 
    v.kev, 
    a.hostname, 
    a.id as asset_id,
    e.type as edge_type,
    e.src
FROM findings f
JOIN vuln v ON f.id LIKE '%' -- wait, let's just use standard JOINs
JOIN edges of_e ON of_e.dst = v.id AND of_e.type = 'OF'
JOIN findings f2 ON of_e.src = f2.id
JOIN edges on_e ON on_e.src = f2.id AND on_e.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON on_e.dst = a.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
LIMIT 20;

input.sql:
SELECT 
    f.id as finding_id, 
    v.cve, 
    v.cvss, 
    v.kev, 
    a.hostname, 
    a.id as asset_id
FROM findings f
JOIN edges of_e ON of_e.src = f.id AND of_e.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON of_e.dst = v.id
JOIN edges on_e ON on_e.src = f.id AND on_e.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON on_e.dst = a.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    f.id as finding_id, 
    v.cve, 
    v.cvss, 
    v.kev, 
    a.hostname, 
    a.id as asset_id,
    ex.type as exposure_type
FROM findings f
JOIN edges of_e ON of_e.src = f.id AND of_e.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON of_e.dst = v.id
JOIN edges on_e ON on_e.src = f.id AND on_e.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON on_e.dst = a.id
JOIN edges ex ON ex.dst = a.id AND ex.type = 'EXPOSES'
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    f.id as finding_id, 
    v.cve, 
    v.cvss, 
    v.kev, 
    a.hostname, 
    a.id as asset_id
FROM findings f
JOIN edges of_e ON of_e.src = f.id AND of_e.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON of_e.dst = v.id
JOIN edges on_e ON on_e.src = f.id AND on_e.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON on_e.dst = a.id
JOIN edges ex ON ex.dst = a.id AND ex.type = 'EXPOSES'
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
ORDER BY v.cvss DESC, v.epss DESC
LIMIT 20;
